description.narrative: The HCFC Phase out Management Plan (HPMP) Stage II is a programme designed to help South Africa totally phase out the remaining hyd rochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs), which destroy the earth#s protective ozone layer and contribute to global greenhouse gas emissions. The activities for the HPMP Stage II will focus on initiatives for the changing context of the Refrigeration and Air-conditioning (RAC) in the servicing sector in South Africa. These include the policy instruments required to control the supply and demand of HCFCs, non-investment activity to support control of HCFC import and usage, assistance to the Refrigeration Service sector and raising public awareness in the country.
